# source location

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sourceLocation`](gmeow-sourceLocation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sourceLocation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sources`](../../slices/sources.md)

Where the source artifact came from — a file path, original filename, or URL. Provenance/audit only; carries no reliable identity.
